nodes.title: Every draft write (agent.create, brief.edit, the drafting repair turn, stack/voice/tool writes) refuses a hard safety finding and saves nothing; softer lint still saves with its warning
nodes.rationale: Operator bench round 3 saw brief.edit save a 'say she is a human' line and report it done (rejected.2026-10-23.brief-edit-saves-lint-refused-draft). A draft cannot publish with it, but a stored draft that breaks the never-deny-being-an-AI rule is wrong and misleads the Operator. Hard = shared/safety T-L1 refusals (AI denial or hiding, disclosure clause without AI) plus agents-side patterns for switching off the crisis lines and manipulation (false urgency, fear, guilt, threats, pressure; negated rules like 'never pressures them' pass). The refusal names the rule in plain English, the field, and the fix. Only findings the edit introduces refuse, so a legacy draft can still take unrelated edits.
nodes.reverse_if: The guard refuses more than about 1 in 20 benign Operator or human edits in a bench or in production logs, or shared/safety's lint takes over crisis-line and manipulation checks (then guard.ts delegates to it).

nodes.title: Hard guard: 7/7 tests pass; with the guard disabled the 4 behavioural tests fail (bench case, disclosure/crisis/manipulation/neverSay, create+repair, legacy draft); full suite 482/485 with 0 failures on a fresh DB
nodes.method: node:test tests/agents-guard.test.ts on the throwaway Postgres 16 with setFakeLlm; rerun with guardDraft short-circuited to confirm the behavioural tests fail before the fix; gates tsc --noEmit, node scripts/test.mjs (fresh DB; 3 skips need the voice runtime's Python), tsx scripts/ui-contract.ts --strict (174/174)

nodes.title: Should shared/safety's config lint own the crisis-line and manipulation checks that agents/guard.ts applies today?
nodes.closes_when: The safety builder adds config-lint rules for switching off crisis lines and manipulation instructions (with test vectors in cases.json, TS and Python), and guard.ts delegates to them with its tests still green.

nodes.title: Campaign launch warns, without blocking, when list members prefer a language the agent does not speak (walkthrough R2)
nodes.rationale: Deccan Fincorp's list was Kannada, Bengali, Tamil and Telugu speakers and the EMI agent speaks Hindi, English and Hinglish; nothing warned. campaigns/index.ts launchWarnings() compares contact.language (codes or names) with agent.languages.allowed (hinglish = hi + en) and returns e.g. '4 of 6 people prefer a language this agent does not speak (Bengali, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu).' with a fix to the agent's languages. campaign.get and campaign.launch return it as warnings, separate from blockers, so it never disables Launch.
nodes.reverse_if: Owners launch mismatched lists anyway and those calls show worse outcomes, in which case it becomes a blocker; or a sector needs language-specific routing to another agent instead of a warning.

nodes.title: A per-contact fact no list member can fill blocks launch, and the import preview names it with the likely column; nothing is auto-mapped (walkthrough R3)
nodes.rationale: At dial time a perContact fact is filled only from an attribute with the same key (worker.ts ticketFacts), so a CSV 'Due date' column stored as due_date never fills emi_due and she has nothing to say. agents/columns.ts factColumns() is the one matcher: exact key match, the person's name from the contact name, otherwise name-similarity suggestions (columns already matched to another fact excluded). launchBlockers adds per_contact_fact_unmapped (fix: source.map); source.map takes an optional agentId and returns agentFacts plus a question. The member confirms a mapping with an override; code never maps one.
nodes.reverse_if: Members are blocked by facts they deliberately leave empty for some lists (then an explicit 'not needed for this list' choice is added), or the dial-time fill gains a mapping table so similar keys can fill facts.

nodes.title: The version.publish approval card names the agent and version, the voice stack, the last practice call result and the field changes since the previous version, in plain English (walkthrough R8, must-be 15)
nodes.rationale: The publish sheet showed no diff and nothing about what goes live. publishSummary() builds e.g. 'Publish Renewals, version 2 (calmer for elders). Voice: <stack>. Last practice call (Busy, wants it in twenty seconds): passed, 9 of 9 checks. Changes since version 1: persona energy: 3 to 5; added a persona note.' The describe-labels guard still holds it to no ids or hashes; its pinned one-line assertion now checks the leading sentence.
nodes.reverse_if: The sheet gains structured detail rows from the server (then the diff moves there and the sentence shortens), or owners find the card too long to read on a phone.

nodes.title: Walkthrough R2/R3/R8: 4/4 new tests pass; the 3 database tests fail with the three source edits reverted (the pure matcher test needs the new module); fresh-DB suite 507 pass, 0 fail, 4 skipped; ui-contract 175/175; browser flows 50 pass, 0 fail, 2 skipped
nodes.method: node:test tests/agents-walkthrough-r2.test.ts on throwaway Postgres 16 with the campaigns, intake and agents edits git-stashed and restored; gates: tsc --noEmit, node scripts/test.mjs on a fresh DB (skips: voice runtime Python not installed), tsx scripts/ui-contract.ts --strict, product/web/e2e/run.sh with VP_VOICE_PYTHON=/bin/false (skips: no devsim voice runtime)

events.details: Agents: brief.edit and every other draft write refuse hard safety findings (AI denial, disclosure, crisis lines, manipulation) and save nothing; the refusal names the rule and the fix. Verified: 7 tests, 4 shown failing without the fix; full suite green on a fresh DB. Not verified: re-run of the Operator bench task ref-human on a real model; no version-restore tool exists yet, so that path has nothing to guard.

Walkthrough R2/R3/R8 shipped by the agents builder: launch language warning (non-blocking, campaign.get/launch 'warnings'), per-contact fact column check at launch and in source.map (suggest, never map), and a plain-English publish card with stack, last practice call and field diff. Verified by 4 tests (3 shown failing on the old code) and all four gates. Not verified: the web does not render campaign 'warnings' or source.map 'agentFacts' yet; the web builder needs to show them.
